other_conditions: Applicants must hold a D.Pharm or B.Pharm degree, or must employ such degree holders and provide proof at the time of submission or final approval.
Organizations or NGOs applying for the scheme must employ D.Pharm/B.Pharm degree holders and produce proof of such employment at submission or final approval.
In government hospital premises, including medical colleges, the preferred agencies are reputed NGOs or charitable organisations, although individual applicants are also eligible.
benefits_summary: The scheme offers generic medicines at 50‑90% lower prices than branded drugs and provides financial incentives to Kendra owners, including up to ₹5  lakh per year and a one‑time ₹2  lakh for centres in specified regions or run by women, persons with disabilities, SC/ST entrepreneurs.
